extracted.intended_audience: researchers, prospective applicants, donors, journalists, and members of the public looking up CRI-funded scientists
extracted.subtask_description: A searchable directory page listing Cancer Research Institute (CRI)–funded scientists with filters to narrow results by grant program, institution, location, cancer type, and award year. The page presents individual scientist entries (name, credentials, institution, and award type).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search filters (page-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for CRI Funded Scientists using the filters below:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter categories shown on the page: Grant Type, Grantee, Institution, Location, Cancer Type, Award Year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funded scientist entry format
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual funded scientist entries appear as name, degree(s), institution, and award type(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from the page: 'Emmanuela Adjei-Sowah, PhD — Vanderbilt University — Postdoctoral Fellow'; 'Valsamo Anagnostou, MD, PhD — Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine — Clinical Accelerator, CLIP Investigator'; 'Robbie G. Majzner, MD — Dana-Farber Cancer Institute — CRI Lloyd J. Old STAR'. Entries commonly include multiple award designations when applicable.
